I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or sprayed medicine for the crops, and the agro-dealer in the nearby town is often out of stock anyway. We will use the manure from our goats and cattle to give strength to the soil, and we will plant the seed we kept from last year's harvest. My brothers and I will clear the land with hoes and pull the weeds with our hands when the rains come, because this plot is small enough for our family to manage alone without spending cash we do not have.
